info.title: Gateway admin data retention and export API
info.description:
Per-organization retention of traces, usage and audit events, and their export as NDJSON or CSV. The worker deletes data older than the organization's retention periods every hour, in bounded batches; a period that is not set keeps that data indefinitely. Deleted data cannot be recovered: export it first if it must be kept elsewhere. Every route requires a human admin session and responds with `Cache-Control: no-store`.

Authenticated with a session cookie or an agent token (`Authorization: Bearer gwa_…`), which acts only in its agent's organization.

get.description: Permission `retention_read` (owner, admin, operator, auditor, read-only member; org-wide only). Not audited. An organization that never set a policy gets every period null and `version` 0, with no `ETag`.

200.description: The policy, with what the purge has removed under it.

ETag.description: Present once the policy has been set.

put.description: Permission `retention_write` (owner, admin; org-wide only). Audited as `retention_policy.set`. Replaces the whole policy: a period that is null or left out keeps that data indefinitely. Shortening a period lets the next hourly purge delete everything now older than it. Each purge batch reads the policy as it stands, so a period lengthened or removed stops deletion under the old one.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key. A retry with the same key and request replays the stored outcome; a different request under the same key is `idempotency_conflict`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: `*` for any state, or the policy's current `ETag`.

422.description: `invalid_retention_policy` (a period outside its bounds, or `usage_days` set without a `trace_days` at most equal to it) or `request_body_unprocessable` (unknown or mistyped fields).

get.description: Permission `audit_read` (owner, admin, auditor; org-wide only). Not audited. Every export of the organization, newest first: what it covered, who asked, and how it ended. Records are kept as long as audit events.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Opaque signed token from `next_page_token`; bound to the actor and ordering.

get.summary: Export usage, traces or audit events
get.description:
Permission by dataset, org-wide only: `usage_read` for `usage`, `trace_read` for `traces`, `audit_read` for `audit-events`. Recorded as an export (see `GET .../exports`: dataset, format, range, requester, and how it ended) and audited as `usage.exported`, `traces.exported` or `audit_events.exported` (entity type `data_export`, entity id the export record) before the first row is sent. An export that fails or whose client leaves early is audited again with outcome `failed`. Streams the rows recorded in `[from, to)`, oldest first. NDJSON has one JSON object per line; CSV has a header row, CRLF line ends, RFC 4180 quoting, and text cells that a spreadsheet would read as a formula (starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tab or CR) prefixed with `'`. Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC; JSON metadata is a JSON object in NDJSON and its JSON text in CSV. Rows recorded while the export runs may or may not appear. If the store fails midway the connection is closed before the body ends. Columns:

- `usage`: `usage_id`, `recorded_at`, `reservation_id`, `team_id`, `service_account_id`, `deployment`, `model`, `currency`, `confidence`, `completeness`, `finality`, `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `cached_input_tokens`, `reasoning_tokens`, `other_tokens`, `amount_minor` (units of 10⁻⁶ of the currency's smallest unit), `batch_id`, `custom_id`, `model_master`.
- `traces`: `trace_id`, `recorded_at`, `finalized_at`, `reservation_id`, `correlation_id`, `team_id`, `service_account_id`, `status`, `outcome`, `provider_request_id`, `deployment`, `model`, `provider_family`, `input_bound`, `output_cap`, `price_version`, `pricing_confidence`, `currency`, `amount_minor`, `batch_id`, `custom_id`, `model_master`. Metadata only: no prompt or completion is stored.
- `audit-events`: `event_id`, `occurred_at`, `actor_type`, `actor_user_id`, `actor_service_account_id`, `team_id`, `action`, `entity_type`, `entity_id`, `outcome`, `request_id`, `metadata`, `before_metadata`, `after_metadata`.

In `usage` and `traces`, `batch_id` (`batch_<uuid>`) and `custom_id` name the batch line a row came from; both are empty (`null` in NDJSON) for a request made on its own. `model_master` is the master record (D-033) the request's deployment was linked to when it was served; empty for none.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive start, RFC 3339. Defaults to 30 days before `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive end, RFC 3339; at most 366 days after `from`. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: batch_id
parameters.description: `usage` and `traces` only: just the lines of this batch (D-021), named `batch_<uuid>` or by the bare UUID. Any other value, or the parameter on `audit-events`, is a 400.

parameters.name: model_master
parameters.description: `usage` and `traces` only: just the requests served by deployments linked to this master record when they were served (D-033), a card's id (`anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6`) or `org/<slug>`. Any other value, or the parameter on `audit-events`, is a 400.

200.description: The rows, streamed as an attachment named `{dataset}-{from}-{to}.{ndjson|csv}`.

400.description: `invalid_query`: unknown dataset, format or parameter, a malformed timestamp, or a range that is empty or longer than 366 days.

403.description: `forbidden`: the dataset's read permission is not held org-wide.

agentToken.description: An agent token (`Authorization: Bearer gwa_…`), for automation: it acts as its agent, only in the agent's organization, with the agent's role. Created with `POST /api/admin/v1/organizations/{org}/agents/{agent_id}/tokens` or, on the server, `gateway agent create`.

Forbidden.description: `forbidden`: the actor lacks the required permission for the organization.

trace_days.description: Days traces are kept after they are recorded; null keeps them indefinitely. Required, and at most `usage_days`, when `usage_days` is set: a trace is removed with its usage.

usage_days.description: Days a request's accounting is kept after its reservation: usage, allocations, price snapshot, settlement record, resolved reconciliation item and trace. A reservation still in progress, or with an open reconciliation item, is kept until it is final. Null keeps usage indefinitely; when set, `trace_days` must be set too and not exceed it.

audit_days.description: Days audit events are kept after they occur; null keeps them indefinitely.

trace_days.description: Days traces are kept after they are recorded; null keeps them indefinitely. Required, and at most `usage_days`, when `usage_days` is set: a trace is removed with its usage.

usage_days.description: Days a request's accounting is kept after its reservation: usage, allocations, price snapshot, settlement record, resolved reconciliation item and trace. A reservation still in progress, or with an open reconciliation item, is kept until it is final. Null keeps usage indefinitely; when set, `trace_days` must be set too and not exceed it.

audit_days.description: Days audit events are kept after they occur; null keeps them indefinitely.

version.description: 0 until first set; then the `ETag` version.

last_purged_at.description: When the purge last ran for this organization.

purged.description: Rows the purge has removed since the policy was first set.

reservations.description: Each with its usage and accounting records.

id.description: The entity id of the export's audit events.

actor_user_id.description: Null once the user is deleted.

status.description: `abandoned`: the client left before the end. `streaming` stays on a record whose gateway stopped mid-export, until the record ages out with audit events.

batch_id.description: Present when the export was limited to one batch's lines.

model_master.description: Present when the export was limited to one master record's requests.
